description: Upload bytes to Google Drive from a blob (blob_key). Content comes from platform blob storage only — to upload a local file, ingest it into blob storage first (blob_storage_service.store_blob_from_file) and pass the resulting blob_key. Optional parent folder id and mime type override. Returns the new file's id and web view link. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Create a new binary file in Google Drive by uploading bytes sourced from platform blob storage via a required blob_key. Accepts a display name, an optional parent folder id to place it inside, and an optional mime type override (otherwise taken from the blob). Returns the created Drive file's id plus its webViewLink for sharing. This is the write counterpart to drive_download_file (which reads Drive bytes into a blob); use drive_create_folder first if you need a destination folder id. The verb never reads an arbitrary local filesystem path — to upload a local file, first ingest it into blob storage with store_blob_from_file, then pass the blob_key. Fails gsuite.invalid_params if blob_key is missing.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with the new Drive file id and its web_view_link.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the upload and surface the web_view_link so the operator can open the file directly.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Upload a file into Google Drive from a blob.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: blob_key not supplied. gsuite.not_found: the referenced blob_key does not exist. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: supply a blob_key (ingest a local file via store_blob_from_file first if needed). gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account.
